about: Labelled messages a candidate might type in the Interview panel (CFS-145). expect is the route: score (send to the Evaluator), reply (answer it, ask the same question again) or skip (move on). On main every message is scored.

report.question: Tell me about a time you improved a report or dashboard that other people relied on.

conflict.question: Describe a disagreement with a teammate and how you resolved it.

learning.question: Tell me about a time you had to learn a new tool quickly.
